_readme: One entry per SETTLED benchmark alert. status: clean | meltdown | unclassified. Use exclude_from_headline, not the status string, to decide what counts in headline means. Benchmark rows are NOT edited by this file.
_rule: meltdown = Unstable Meltdown / Oshur alert (event ids 176-193, 248-250): the retired VM engine scored diluted shares, so its Briers form a separate pool (issue #47, oracle/benchmark/README.md mismatches 1-2). clean = standard alert with a healthy map. unclassified = cannot be checked. exclude_from_headline is true for meltdown rows.
_caveat: Clean labels for standard alerts come from the fix doc (not re-measurable from this repo: the snapshot archive lives on the VM). See oracle/benchmark/README.md, mismatch 6.
